white.$description: Pure white: reversed-out labels on the brand and on deep status fills.

black.$description: Pure black: modal scrims, the dark theme's shadow ink and the glass shadow.

primary-dark.$description: Indigo Deep (indigo-600), fixed in both themes. The light theme's primary, and the dark theme's primary container.

primary-light.$description: Indigo Light (indigo-400), fixed. The dark theme's secondary and the light theme's inverse primary.

primary-lighter.$description: Indigo Pale (indigo-300), fixed. Text on the dark primary container; the light primary container.

seerr.$description: Seerr Indigo (indigo-500): the Seerr accent and the app's own brand colour, the dark theme's primary.

radarr.$description: Radarr Amber, the movies accent. A fill label on it takes ink-on-bright: white measures 2.15:1.

sonarr.$description: Sonarr Violet, the series accent; also the brand gradient's end.

qbittorrent.$description: qBittorrent Blue, the torrent client accent.

transmission.$description: Transmission Crimson: walked off the brand red so it clears readarr (ΔE 10.8) and the error tone (ΔE 8.8).

sabnzbd.$description: SABnzbd Gold, a usenet client accent.

nzbget.$description: NZBGet Green, a usenet client accent.

nginx-proxy-manager.$description: Nginx Proxy Manager Vermilion, the brand value unchanged: a red-orange clear of the amber band.

plex.$description: Plex Bronze: deliberately not brand gold #E5A00D, which collides with sabnzbd and the fault tone.

dashboard.$description: Dashboard tab pill: the app's own indigo.

activity.$description: Section Cyan (cyan-500), the Activity tab pill. A section, not a service, and never a status hue.

search.$description: Section Purple (purple-500), the Search tab pill.

settings.$description: Section Teal (teal-500), the Settings tab pill.

success.$description: GREEN (green-500): available or complete. A fill byte; as text it always goes through the tone walk.

success-container.$description: Deep green (green-800): the dark success container, and text on the light one.

warning.$description: AMBER (yellow-400): a fault, never the backlog. Deliberately not radarr's amber-500.

error-container.$description: Deep red (red-800): the dark error container, and text on the light one.

ink-on-bright.$description: gray-900: the label a bright fill takes where white loses the contrast measurement.

surface.$description: Artwork stand-in (a missing poster, an album without cover). Fixed dark in both themes: artwork is not palette.

well.$description: The letterboxed well behind a backdrop; fixed dark in both themes.

dim-ink.$description: Secondary text on a plate: 5.49:1 on the plate surface, 7.02:1 on the well.

xxs.$description: Inside components only: glyph-to-label gap, between two lines of a row.

xs.$description: Minimal spacing for tight layouts; chip vertical padding.

s.$description: Inside components only: chip inner padding, nav bar inner padding.

sm.$description: Small spacing for related elements; badge padding.

m.$description: Inside components only: row line gaps, inner plates.

md.$description: Compact spacing: grid and carousel gaps, button vertical padding.

ml.$description: Inside components only: nav pill horizontal padding.

lg.$description: The default: page gutter, card padding, input horizontal padding.

xs2.$description: Small-object geometry: a poster corner in dense rails.

md.$description: The default: cards, buttons, inputs, posters, snackbars, list tiles.

lg.$description: Dialogs, bottom-sheet top corners, grouped settings.

pill.$description: Selected affordances only: the nav indicator and segment pills. Never a general corner.

full.$description: Metadata pills (tags, genres, ratings). Never an interactive container.

breakpoint.$description: Window regimes, never a device check.

nav-compact.$description: Below this width the floating bar switches to compact item targets.

desktop-mobile.$description: Below this width a desktop window paints the touch shell under a bare drag strip.

touch-rail.$description: At or above this width a touch build moves from the bottom bar to a side rail.

desktop-compact.$description: Below this width the desktop shell uses its compact variants.

content-well.$description: The widest the main content well may grow, on any shell.

desktop-min-width.$description: Narrowest a desktop window may be dragged: a small phone's width.

desktop-min-height.$description: Shortest a desktop window may be dragged: the compact artboard's height.

landscape-aspect.$description: Aspect ratio at or above which a frame puts two things side by side instead of stacking. A shape, not a width.

confirmation-hold.$description: How long a transient success check replaces a button's icon before reverting.

service-soft-container.$description: A service accent's soft container: icon backgrounds and chips.

service-glow.$description: Centre of a signature card's accent glow. A grid repeating the treatment takes a fraction of it.

hero-scrim-rest.$description: Mid stop of the hero scrim at rest; it deepens to opaque as the hero collapses.

hero-scrim-deep.$description: Top stop of the hero scrim once collapsed, so the art recedes behind chrome.

status-badge.$description: The surface behind a status badge laid over artwork.

shadow.$description: Two-layer stacks (a tight contact shadow plus a wide ambient one), deeper on dark. Flat is the default; a surface earns a shadow only when it must read as lifted. Each layer's opacity is per theme.

level-3.$description: Sheets, popovers, hero surfaces, a poster mid-flight.

glass.$description: The floating navigation bar: a deep ambient shadow plus a 1px top highlight.

sans.$description: The bundled Inter variable font (wght 100–900, opsz 14–32). Every role is set in it.

mono.$description: Code, logs, hashes and anything compared by eye in columns, in resolution order. Never the bare 'monospace' alias, which Apple platforms do not have.

large.$description: Rare editorial and onboarding moments. The only roles allowed 800.
Section headers. The app-bar title is this role at 700.

subtitle.$description: A service's own name in its app bar, one step under Title.

panel-header.$description: An h2 inside a page: a Dockge stack, an NPM host, a TrueNAS console section.

medium.$description: Card titles; KPI values, read at 700.

row-title.$description: The primary line of a row that is a name, not a sentence: a device, a session, a proxy host.

small.$description: Small titles and dense card headers.

large.$description: The widest prose measure: overviews and descriptions.

medium.$description: Running text, metadata, empty-state copy, input text.

data.$description: The answer in a row: an attention item, a queue entry, a table cell. Never smaller than the label describing it.

small.$description: The 11px floor. Nothing in the app renders smaller.

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase kicker above a section or a single-value readout. The one role whose tracking is authored; set the text uppercase.

chrome.$description: Dense desktop-shell chrome off the ramp. Its size is both the default and the enforced floor.
